```python
# Hypothesis: cut-off traces contain repetitive verification after a solution, separable from productive long reasoning.
print("Sample keys:", list(g1[0]['samples'][0]))
for r in g1:
    s=r['samples'][0]
    good=s.get('correct',s.get('grade'))
    if not good:
        print("\n",r['id'],"reference",r['answer'],{k:v for k,v in s.items() if k not in ['text','token_ids','tokens']})
        t=s.get('text','')
        print("Problem:",byid[r['id']]['problem'][:220])
        print("Middle:",t[len(t)//2:len(t)//2+250].replace('\n',' '))
        print("End:",t[-280:].replace('\n',' '))
```
